name: organize-downloads
author: DeskApp
trigger: 整理下载|organize downloads|下载文件夹|sort downloads
description: 自动整理下载文件夹：按文件类型分到子目录（images/documents/archives/installers/other），删除临时文件，归档旧文件。
instructions:
# Organize Downloads

## macOS/Linux
```bash
cd ~/Downloads
mkdir -p images documents archives installers other 2>/dev/null
for f in *.jpg *.jpeg *.png *.gif *.svg *.webp *.heic 2>/dev/null; do mv "$f" images/ 2>/dev/null; done
for f in *.pdf *.doc* *.xls* *.ppt* *.txt *.md *.csv 2>/dev/null; do mv "$f" documents/ 2>/dev/null; done
for f in *.zip *.tar* *.gz *.7z *.rar 2>/dev/null; do mv "$f" archives/ 2>/dev/null; done
find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.download" -delete 2>/dev/null
echo "Done!"
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads
mkdir images,documents,archives,installers,other -Force
Get-ChildItem *.jpg,*.png,*.gif,*.svg,*.webp | Move-Item -Dest images/
Get-ChildItem *.pdf,*.doc*,*.xls*,*.ppt*,*.txt,*.md,*.csv | Move-Item -Dest documents/
Get-ChildItem *.zip,*.tar*,*.gz,*.7z,*.rar | Move-Item -Dest archives/
Remove-Item *.download -Force
Write-Host "Done!"
```

name: clean-desktop
author: DeskApp
trigger: 整理桌面|clean desktop|桌面太乱|清理桌面
description: 自动整理桌面：截图移到 Screenshots 文件夹，文档移到 Documents，按日期归档旧文件。
instructions:
# Clean Desktop

## macOS/Linux
```bash
cd ~/Desktop
mkdir -p Screenshots Archive 2>/dev/null
for f in Screenshot* 屏幕快照* 2>/dev/null; do mv "$f" Screenshots/ 2>/dev/null; done
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -mtime +30 2>/dev/null | while read f; do
  d=$(date -r "$f" +%Y-%m 2>/dev/null); mkdir -p "Archive/$d"; mv "$f" "Archive/$d/"
done
echo "Done!"
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\Desktop
mkdir Screenshots,Archive -Force
Get-ChildItem Screenshot* | Move-Item -Dest Screenshots/
$d=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM'); mkdir "Archive/$d" -Force
Get-ChildItem -File | Where {$_.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-30)} | Move-Item -Dest "Archive/$d/"
Write-Host "Done!"
```

name: system-status
author: DeskApp
trigger: 系统状态|system status|CPU|内存|磁盘|电脑怎么样
description: 查看系统状态：CPU 使用率、内存占用、磁盘空间、运行时间、网络信息。
instructions:
# System Status

## macOS
```bash
echo "=== CPU ===" && top -l 1 -n 0 | grep "CPU usage"
echo "=== Memory ===" && vm_stat | head -10
echo "=== Disk ===" && df -h / | tail -1
echo "=== Uptime ===" && uptime
```

## Linux
```bash
echo "=== CPU ===" && top -bn1 | grep "Cpu(s)"
echo "=== Memory ===" && free -h
echo "=== Disk ===" && df -h / | tail -1
echo "=== Uptime ===" && uptime
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
Write-Host "=== CPU ===" ; Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select LoadPercentage
Write-Host "=== Memory ===" ; Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select TotalVisibleMemorySize,FreePhysicalMemory
Write-Host "=== Disk ===" ; Get-PSDrive C | Select Used,Free
Write-Host "=== Uptime ===" ; (Get-Date) - (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime
```

name: batch-rename
author: DeskApp
trigger: 批量重命名|rename files|改名
description: 批量重命名文件：添加前缀/后缀、替换文字、序号重命名、按日期重命名。
instructions:
# Batch Rename

## macOS/Linux (bash)
```bash
# Add prefix
for f in *.jpg; do mv "$f" "vacation-$f"; done
# Numbered
n=1; for f in *.jpg; do mv "$f" "photo-$(printf '%03d' $n).jpg"; ((n++)); done
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
# Add prefix
Get-ChildItem *.jpg | ForEach-Object { Rename-Item $_ -NewName "vacation-$($_.Name)" }
# Numbered
$n=1; Get-ChildItem *.jpg | ForEach-Object { Rename-Item $_ -NewName "photo-{0:D3}.jpg" -f $n; $n++ }
```

name: archive-project
author: DeskApp
trigger: 归档项目|archive project|备份项目|打包项目
description: 归档项目文件夹：压缩为 .tar.gz/.zip，排除 node_modules/.git/__pycache__，按日期命名。
instructions:
# Archive Project

## macOS/Linux
```bash
cd ~/projects/my-project
tar -czf "../$(basename $(pwd))-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" --exclude='node_modules' --exclude='.git' --exclude='__pycache__' --exclude='dist' .
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\projects\my-project
$name=Split-Path -Leaf (Get-Location)
Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath "..\$name-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd').zip"
```

name: find-duplicates
author: DeskApp
trigger: 查找重复|find duplicates|重复文件|去重
description: 查找并报告重复文件：按 MD5 哈希匹配，显示重复组和可释放空间。
instructions:
# Find Duplicates

## macOS/Linux
```bash
cd ~/Documents
find . -type f -not -name '.DS_Store' -exec md5 -r {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort | awk '{h=$1; $1=""; if(h==p)print; p=h}'
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\Documents
Get-ChildItem -File -Recurse | Group-Object -Property {(Get-FileHash $_ -Algorithm MD5).Hash} | Where Count -gt 1 | ForEach {$_.Group}
```

name: find-large-files
author: DeskApp
trigger: 大文件|large files|磁盘空间|disk space|空间不够
description: 查找大文件：找出目录下最大的 20 个文件，显示大小和路径，帮助释放磁盘空间。
instructions:
# Find Large Files

## macOS/Linux
```bash
cd ~/Documents
find . -type f -exec ls -lh {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort -k5 -hr | head -20
find . -type f -size +100M -exec ls -lh {} \; 2>/dev/null
du -sh */ 2>/dev/null | sort -hr | head -10
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
cd $env:USERPROFILE\Documents
Get-ChildItem -File -Recurse | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select -First 20 | Format-Table Name,@{n='Size';e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,1)}}
Get-ChildItem -File -Recurse | Where Length -gt 100MB | Format-Table Name,Length
```

name: network-diagnosis
author: DeskApp
trigger: 网络诊断|network diagnosis|网速|DNS|ping|网络故障
description: 网络诊断：检查网络连通性、DNS 解析、路由跳数、WiFi 信号强度。
instructions:
# Network Diagnosis

## macOS/Linux
```bash
ping -c 2 8.8.8.8 2>/dev/null | grep 'bytes from\|100% packet loss'
nslookup github.com 2>/dev/null | grep -A1 'Name:'
ifconfig en0 2>/dev/null | grep 'inet '
netstat -an | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
Test-Connection 8.8.8.8 -Count 2
Resolve-DnsName github.com
Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where InterfaceAlias -like '*Ethernet*'
Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established | Measure-Object | Select Count
```

name: password-generator
author: DeskApp
trigger: password|密码|生成密码|generate password|随机密码
description: 密码生成器：生成强随机密码，支持自定义长度和字符集。
instructions:
# Password Generator

## macOS/Linux
```bash
LC_CTYPE=C tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9!@#$%^&*' < /dev/urandom | head -c 16; echo
LC_CTYPE=C tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' < /dev/urandom | head -c 20; echo
openssl rand -hex 16
```

## Windows (PowerShell)
```powershell
Add-Type -Assembly System.Web
[System.Web.Security.Membership]::GeneratePassword(16, 4)
```

## All platforms (Python)
```bash
python3 -c "import secrets,string; print(''.join(secrets.choice(string.ascii_letters+string.digits+'!@#') for _ in range(16)))"
```
